subject: 🏋️ Friday — Consolidated Strength + PT, Light (Wk 8 Deload)
html:
Tomorrow you have the first lift since the Presidio HM — Consolidated Strength + PT at Cañada College, kept deliberately light. This is a re-introduction session, not a progression session. The plan says "light" and I mean it: you're 5 days post a hard, under-fueled half marathon (suffer 235, your highest of the build), and Sunday's 10-mi long run with fueling rehearsal is the priority this week. The gym tomorrow just wakes the patterns up.

Dynamic warm-up: foam roll (T-spine extensions, 8–10 reps) → 90/90 PAILs (30 sec each direction) → banded lateral walks (10 each) → Spanish squat hold (30 sec) → Copenhagen plank (20 sec each side).

Session — PT block first, then loaded work:

  • Side plank w/ hip abduction (PT): BW, 8 reps each side — top toe pointing to floor
  • Dead bug w/ banded pulldown (PT): light band, 2–3 × 10 slow marches
  • Chin tuck + lifts (PT): 2 reps each direction (front, diag L, diag R), 3-sec hold
  • Bulgarian split squat: 20 lbs/hand (backed off from Rx 25 — deload week, first session back), 3 × 8
  • Single-leg RDL (contralateral): 20 lbs (backed off from Rx 25), 3 × 8 — watch the right hamstring here. If the twinge from Wednesday is still present, lighten further or sub bodyweight. Don't grind through it.
  • Romanian deadlift: 135 lb w/ straps (backed off from Rx 165 — deload), 3 × 6, 3-sec eccentric. Same hamstring note — right side gets honest attention.
  • Spanish squat hold: light band, 3 × 30 sec — vertical shin, deep bend, isometric. Knee-friendly quad/VMO work.
  • Copenhagen plank: BW, 3 × 30 sec each side
  • Standing calf raise: 135 lb back-rack (backed off from 155 — deload), 3 × 10, full ROM, 2-sec hold at top
  • Reverse Nordic: BW, 3 × 10 — slow, build depth gradually

Focus cue: the right hamstring. It flagged a twinge on Wednesday's easy run (watch item, not an alarm — almost certainly HM descent residue). The RDL and single-leg RDL directly load it. Warm up with a few gentle hamstring sweeps before the loaded work, and treat any sharpening as a stop signal — drop the weight or skip the exercise. We need this leg healthy for Sunday and the next 4.5 weeks.

Where you are: Week 8 of 12, deload. 30 days to race day. Knee has been 1/5 every session since Presidio (the most important signal of the whole build). If the knee reads 2+ tomorrow, drop all loaded lower body and do PT + mobility only — non-negotiable. Sunday is the 10-mi long run with fueling rehearsal (first Maurten Gel 100 practice at effort — the #1 Presidio fix). The gym tomorrow protects Sunday, not the other way around.

Tonight: lay out gym clothes and straps. Protein + carbs at dinner. Bed by 10.
